subject: Vendor onboarding onramp + capacity escalation for Acme Corp renewal
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecorp.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: 2028-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding refresh + renewal capacity bump (Acme)

Hi Vivek / Laura,

Quick note as we start the renewal runway for Acme: procurement would like Redwood to complete a vendor onboarding refresh in our portal before we can approve the 30% capacity uplift and the 12-month term extension.

What's required from your side:
- Updated vendor profile in our portal (link below)
- SOC 2 attestation or equivalent evidence
- SSO / SAML configuration details for audit
- Updated SOW amendment (DocuSign preferred)

Timeline: our procurement review team needs the onboarding completed by July 20 to align with our quarter close. We can fast-track approval if evidence is uploaded and we have a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones.

Attached: Acme_Renewal_Request_2028.pdf (summary sheet).
Procurement portal: https://procure.acmecorp.com/vendor-onboard/12345

Can you confirm who will own the portal upload and whether Redwood can provide a short-term burst slot while the PO is routed? That would help avoid service disruption during the renewal window.

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Doe
Head of SaaS Ops | Acme Corp
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecorp.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding refresh + renewal capacity bump (Acme)

Jane — thanks for the clear checklist. We'll own the portal work. Forwarding a proposed MAP (attached) and an internal owner list.

High level plan (short):
- Today: Laura will open the vendor profile in Acme portal and confirm required fields.
- By 7/6: Rishi to upload SOC2 attestation and SSO metadata to the portal and to the shared secure link.
- By 7/12: We’ll queue the SOW amendment via DocuSign; ETA for signature 7/18.
- By 7/20: Target procurement approval and PO issuance.

Regarding burst capacity: we can enable a 72-hour burst slot on Dedicated for the renewal window at a small add-on fee; I’ve put a note in the MAP. If procurement needs a guaranteed buffer earlier, we can add a temporary capacity token while PO routes — let me know and we’ll add it to the SOW amendment.

Attaching: MAP_Draft_Acme_2028.docx (draft).

Action items for Acme: confirm the SSO endpoint and the procurement contact for PO routing.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-05T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding refresh + renewal capacity bump (Acme)

On Fri, Jul 2, 2028 at 11:03 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Attaching: MAP_Draft_Acme_2028.docx (draft).

I can own the evidence upload. I have the SOC2 attestation PDF on file (SOC2_Attestation_Acme_2027.pdf) and will upload to their portal and the secure S3 link by EOD 7/6.

I’ll also export the SAML metadata from our IdP and paste the XML into the portal field unless Acme prefers an SP-initiated setup.

Ping me if procurement asks for additional controls; I’ll coordinate with Security.

—Rishi
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecorp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: 2028-07-07T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding refresh + renewal capacity bump (Acme)

Thanks Vivek and Rishi — that timeline looks good. A couple quick clarifications:
- We will accept SOC2_Attestation_Acme_2027.pdf in the portal.
- For SSO, SP-initiated is preferred. Procurement will also need an invoice contact for PO creation (procurement@acmecorp.com).

Regarding the burst: Procurement prefers we avoid contract add-ons, but they will accept a short-term letter confirming temporary capacity while PO is in flight. If you can provide a one-page letter (PDF) that states availability and estimated fees, we can accept that and proceed to PO once onboarding passes.

I’ll prepare the PO template once the vendor profile is updated.

Thanks,
Jane
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmecorp.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-25T16:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding refresh + renewal capacity bump (Acme)

Jane — quick status update and attachments.

Status: onboarding fields completed in Acme portal; SOC2 attestation uploaded; SAML metadata uploaded (SP-initiated configured). Laura confirmed the vendor record and I posted the MAP to the HubSpot record.

Attached to this thread: SOC2_Attestation_Acme_2027.pdf, temporary_capacity_letter_Acme_0725.pdf.

Temporary capacity note: we issued the one-page temporary capacity letter (attached) covering a 72-hour burst at the standard burst rate. No SOW amendment fee unless Acme requests extended reserved capacity. DocuSign link for the SOW amendment: https://docusign.com/ACME-SOW-789 — we recommend routing the amendment with the PO.

Next steps (for Acme):
- Procurement to confirm PO path and invoice contact (procurement@acmecorp.com)
- Sign SOW amendment in DocuSign so we can finalize capacity pricing

Thanks everyone — Priyom, can you confirm we’ve also uploaded the audit CSV to the secure folder?

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
